decisions.reason: It builds very directly on the firm's existing market-data and analytics knowledge, so absorptive capacity is high and the product should remain improvable and commercially relevant.

As a tariff-calculator product line tied closely to the firm's core platform and pricing capabilities, it fits the knowledge base well enough to justify continued support despite only modest website prominence.
The area definition tool complements core operational and integration services, and its strong relatedness to the firm's data and process know-how supports further learning and retention.

Although it remains the most vulnerable of the products kept because of lower visibility and overlap with other tariff tools, it is still close enough to the firm's established expertise to keep and refine rather than withdraw.
